inputs.name: HostLinkService.constructor.store
inputs.description: The host's storage adapter: the service reads device and pairing records from it and, in seen, writes a device record back through saveDevice.

inputs.name: HostLinkService.constructor.sockets
inputs.description: The host's sockets adapter: the service finds the host and device sockets through it, reads their attachments, sends frames to them and closes them.

inputs.name: HostLinkService.toHost.frame
inputs.description: The relay-to-host frame to send, which the sockets adapter serializes as JSON; it is not checked here. When no host socket is open the frame is dropped and is not kept for later.

inputs.name: HostLinkService.notify.event
inputs.description: The event announced to every device, either 'host-online' or 'host-offline'. It is sent to each open device socket as { type: 'relay', event }, and a failed send is neither retried nor kept.

inputs.name: HostLinkService.drop.socket
inputs.description: The socket to end, whoever started the close. It is closed in every case, and the other side is notified only when the socket had an attachment that was not already closed.

inputs.name: HostLinkService.drop.code
inputs.description: The close code the socket is ended with, passed unchanged to the sockets adapter, which does not check it. The relay's callers pass relayCloseCodes values such as 4401 (unauthorized) and 4409 (replaced).

inputs.name: HostLinkService.welcome.socket
inputs.description: The host socket that just opened. It is sent the ready frame, then one device-open frame per open device connection and one pairing-request frame per waiting request, and only then are the devices told host-online.

inputs.name: HostLinkService.welcome.host
inputs.description: The record of the host whose socket just opened. Only its hostId is read, for the ready frame, and the record is neither stored nor changed here.

inputs.name: HostLinkService.seen.deviceId
inputs.description: The id of the device that just connected. A record is written only when a device record with this id already exists, so an unknown id creates nothing.

outputs.name: HostLinkService.toHost
outputs.description: True when the frame was handed to the open host socket. False when no host socket is open or the send failed, and nothing is kept for later.

outputs.name: HostLinkService.notify
outputs.description: Nothing is returned: the notice is sent to each device socket, and the result of each send is ignored.

outputs.name: HostLinkService.drop
outputs.description: Nothing is returned: the socket is closed, and the other side is notified only when the socket had an attachment that was not already closed.

outputs.name: HostLinkService.welcome
outputs.description: Nothing is returned: the host receives its ready frame, then its open device connections and waiting pairing requests, and the devices are then told host-online.

outputs.name: HostLinkService.seen
outputs.description: Nothing is returned: the device's lastSeenAt is set to the current time when the device record exists, and nothing is written otherwise.
